callback.assembly:
addi sp,sp,-16
sw ra,12(sp)
limit:
.option rvc
c.li a1,3
.option norvc
guard:
bltu a1,a0,default
shift:
slli a1,a0,2
upper:
lui a2,0x20
addition:
addi a2,a2,0x40
combine:
.option rvc
c.add a1,a2
load:
c.lw a1,0(a1)
suffix:
dispatch:
c.jr a1
.option norvc
case0:
literal_upper:
lui a1,0x30
literal_add:
addi a1,a1,0x40
.option rvc
literal_call:
c.jalr a1
.option norvc
lui a1,0x40
addi a1,a1,0x40
.option rvc
c.jalr a1
.option norvc
addi a3,zero,10
j done
case1:
addi a3,zero,11
j done
default:
addi a3,zero,12
j done

done:
lw ra,12(sp)
addi sp,sp,16
ret
